notes: Hide-and-seek with a seeker and hiders is Party & Casual outright. Childhood Game is still the right mode, but its space-bounded shape is contradicted: the author described a lobby where players wait while the next of several maps is chosen, which is exactly space-staged, so I swapped the shape and kept the options, dropping obstacle-maze since an oversized bedroom is furniture to hide behind rather than a warren and adding teleporter-link for the lobby-to-match transport the separated stage requires. cover-los carries the giant furniture that breaks sightlines for mouse-sized players. space-staged routes P4 and I kept it rather than overriding, because the override only applies when a prompt asks for one continuous map and this one asks for the opposite; the pipeline should know P4 is the deferred part of this build. Following the author's own answer, the bedroom is the map being built now and the circus, pool, garden and trampoline park are later additions.
